title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the immediate streets and corridors surrounding Dominican University of California, from the historic residential blocks of the Dominican neighborhood to the active commercial hubs of downtown San Rafael.

cards.title: The Main Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: Grand Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this primary north-south artery to reach the Conlan Recreation Center and the university's main administrative buildings.
cards.short_summary: Grand Avenue serves as the central thoroughfare connecting the university campus to the residential and commercial areas of San Rafael.
cards.evidence_claim: The Conlan Recreation Center is located at 1475 Grand Avenue, San Rafael, CA 94901.
cards.source_title: Directions - Dominican University of California Athletics
cards.access_notes: Public city street with sidewalk access to campus facilities.

cards.title: Historic Mansion Row
cards.subtitle: Magnolia Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Visit the historic Edgehill Mansion, a 1887 Queen Anne Victorian that now hosts university events and MFA classes.
cards.short_summary: Magnolia Avenue is a tree-lined residential street featuring historic estates and university-owned Victorian buildings like Edgehill Mansion.
cards.evidence_claim: Edgehill Mansion is located at 75 Magnolia Avenue and serves as a home for campus events and classes.
cards.source_title: Edgehill Mansion - Dominican University of CA - MarinArts.org
cards.access_notes: Residential street; mansion access is typically for scheduled university events or classes.

cards.title: The University Front Door
cards.subtitle: Acacia Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Locate the university's official mailing address and main entrance points along this quiet residential block.
cards.short_summary: Acacia Avenue is the official address of Dominican University of California and a key entry point for visitors and new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Dominican University of California is located at 50 Acacia Ave, San Rafael, CA 94901.
cards.source_title: Maps, Directions and Contact | Dominican University of California
cards.access_notes: Public street providing primary access to the campus core.

cards.title: Athletic Complex Access
cards.subtitle: Belle Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Access the John F. Allen Athletics Complex and Kennelly Field for Penguins soccer and lacrosse games.
cards.short_summary: Belle Avenue runs along the eastern edge of the campus, providing direct access to the university's primary outdoor athletic fields.
cards.evidence_claim: The John F. Allen Athletics Complex is located at 890 Belle Avenue, San Rafael, CA 94901.
cards.source_title: Directions - Dominican University of California Athletics
cards.access_notes: Public street; athletic complex access is subject to event schedules.

cards.title: Downtown Dining & Shops
cards.subtitle: Fourth Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk a few blocks west to find local favorites like Aroma Cafe and Art Works Downtown in the city's main commercial hub.
cards.short_summary: Fourth Street is the primary commercial corridor of downtown San Rafael, offering a wide variety of restaurants, cafes, and local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Aroma Cafe is located at 1122 4th Street and has been serving the community since 2002.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial street; business hours vary by establishment.

cards.title: The Sol Food Corridor
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Visit the famous Sol Food for authentic Puerto Rican cuisine, a staple for students and locals alike.
cards.short_summary: Lincoln Avenue is a key north-south street in downtown San Rafael known for its popular dining destinations and proximity to the SMART train.
cards.evidence_claim: Sol Food is located at 901 & 903 Lincoln Ave in San Rafael.
cards.access_notes: Public street; Sol Food is open daily for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: The Arts & Crafts Estate Block
cards.subtitle: Palm Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Admire the historic 1904 Arts & Crafts estates that characterize this prestigious neighborhood adjacent to campus.
cards.short_summary: Palm Avenue is a residential street in the Dominican neighborhood known for its historic architecture and mature tree canopy.
cards.evidence_claim: 178 Palm Avenue is a 1904 estate located adjacent to the Dominican University campus.
cards.source_title: 178 PALM Avenue, San Rafael, CA 94901 - Zillow
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; please respect private property.

cards.title: Chamber & Community Hub
cards.subtitle: Mission Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Find the San Rafael Chamber of Commerce and local professional services just a short walk from the university.
cards.short_summary: Mission Avenue connects the downtown core to the residential areas, housing various civic and professional organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: The San Rafael Chamber of Commerce is located at 817 Mission Avenue, San Rafael, CA 94901.
cards.source_title: San Rafael Chamber of Commerce Business Directory - Calaméo
cards.access_notes: Public street with professional and civic offices.

cards.title: Open Space Access
cards.subtitle: Deer Park Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Access the northern edge of campus and nearby hiking trails through this quiet residential street.
cards.short_summary: Deer Park Avenue is a residential street that borders the northern portion of the university and provides access to local open spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: A residential development is proposed on a site situated at the intersection of Magnolia Avenue and Deer Park Avenue, north of the campus.
cards.access_notes: Public residential street leading to trailheads and open space.

cards.title: The Dominican Neighborhood Core
cards.subtitle: Locust Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk through one of San Rafael's most established residential pockets, known for its historic homes and quiet atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Locust Avenue is a quintessential street within the Dominican neighborhood, featuring a mix of historic architecture and mature landscaping.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dominican neighborhood is known for tree-lined streets with names like Magnolia, Locust, Grand, and Acacia.
cards.source_title: Dominican Neighborhood Real Estate Guide | San Rafael, Marin - Oliver Burgelman
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; ideal for quiet walks near campus.
